_comment: Package-local fixture→schema map for @lifegames/fixtures validation. Decision (plan #04): kept LOCAL to this package rather than overloading @lifegames/schemas/fixture-map.json (which is codegen-generated and freshness-gated for a different purpose). 'raw' entries validate src/generated/<dir>/*.json against the portal-contract raw export schema file. 'postAdapter' entries validate src/post-adapter/<domain>.*.json against a @lifegames/schemas authored/ or generated/ schema (by title). scripts/validate.ts reads this.

raw._comment: kebab on-disk dir → portal-contract raw-schemas/<file>. Every JSON under src/generated/<dir>/ validates against the mapped raw export schema.

postAdapter._comment: post-adapter domain prefix → @lifegames/schemas schema title. src/post-adapter/<domain>.<variation>.json validates against the named schema. starredRepos has no standalone post-adapter schema (it is AdaptedStarredRepo[], an array of widget-pinned-repos-like items) so it is validated structurally by the package's own vitest, not Ajv here.
